text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're training hard to make her dream of becoming Triple Crown champion a reality. During this time, she achieves her goal of placing on the podium in a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the final cap on her preparations, Matikanetannhauser decides to go to the mountains for some special training! I thought she had something rigorous in mind, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Experts take good care of her during her waterfall training, she chows down on some pork stew while she's hiking up the mountain, and she joins a volleyball team for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her final training is much more laid-back than I expected, but it gives me a sense of how easily Matikanetannhauser fits in with new people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When spring comes, it'll finally be time for the Satsuki Sho! We need to work hard to make sure we're ready!
